name: Shiratori Chifuyu
source:
Younger twin sister of [url=/c9029]Chiaki[/url].
Currently serving as the Managing Director of "Shiratori" publishing. 
This is the player character, it's not a real protagonist; you can choose either her or her twin brother to become the listener of M's story.

[Translated from the [url=http://www.ray-software.net/magauta/index.html#2]official website[/url]]
